article.title: Resisting uprooting in the West Bank
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: Israeli settlers are blocking, assaulting, and robbing Palestinian olive harvesters. For some 100,000 families in the West Bank who rely on the harvest for income, this season may decide whether the olive harvest survives at all.
